video_title: The Mystery of the Lost City

scenes.voiceover: A buried city reappeared after a desert storm.

scenes.voiceover: Its stone streets survived beneath the sand.

scenes.voiceover: They found painted rooms and everyday objects.

scenes.voiceover: Dry dunes shielded them from centuries of weather.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic museum-quality archaeological cutaway through desert layers: wind and rain pass across the surface while an intact pottery vessel and painted fragments sit protected in a chamber below; realistic soil strata and artifact surfaces, warm ochre against cool shadow, clear upper-to-lower composition for a slow downward camera move, no labels or lettering.

scenes.voiceover: An empty landscape was hiding a time capsule.
